### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #38554, #37961

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

* change flashback to two phases, first stage lock all regions, second stage do flashback.
* close all cross flashback cluster connection.

Above two reasons, we could remove many useless codes in Flashback. Like history flashback time ranges, auto analyze max time etc.

issue_context.title: restart tidb during flashback, flashback ddl will hang
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

1. run workload
2. run flashback, 
3. during flashback, restart tidb,tikv

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
flashback successfully
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
flashback command hang
RCA： client-go new error msg  can't be processed by tidb patch
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

[root@localhost patch]# ./tidb-server -V
Release Version: v6.3.0-alpha-436-g6c21fd2f2-dirty
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 6c21fd2f2f3f2076d71f47e59c59a9f89fb084da
Git Branch: flashback-2-phase
UTC Build Time: 2022-10-19 08:46:41

review_comments: Why not an empty schema instead?

1. use `-1` to represent all tables and it easy expand to `flashback table` and `flashback database`
2. If use empty slice, it will not add action to `relatedChange.ActionTypes`. see codes:
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/6c55faf034e8c205ffd23126829c637fb8a47451/domain/domain.go#L337-L347

two reasons
1. follow `unlockTable` ddl action
2. It's easier to get domain than in `applyDiff`.
It's useless, because in two phases, we insert new values instead of delete old values. So no need save history time range anymore.
